video_accuracy_source: cross-validated: pooled out-of-fold clip accuracy over all 400 videos, 5 identity-grouped folds (results/cv/cv5_xcep_mm/cv_summary.json), 95% interval 79.2% to 86.2%. Chosen over the 96.2% figure from the 44-video test split because the PPR's weighting basis (Large, Lines and Bagnall, 2019) is cross-validated accuracy and the small split is optimistic.

video_accuracy_alternatives.note: The figure above in video_accuracy is the one fusion.py uses as the weight; this records what else was available.
